shortDescription: Return basic info pertaining to a VMware machine guest

options.name: folder
options.description: Specify a folder location of VMs to gather information from. Examples:    folder: /ha-datacenter/vm    folder: ha-datacenter/vm    folder: /datacenter1/vm    folder: datacenter1/vm    folder: /datacenter1/vm/folder1    folder: datacenter1/vm/folder1    folder: /folder1/datacenter1/vm    folder: folder1/datacenter1/vm    folder: /folder1/datacenter1/vm/folder2

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: show_allocated
options.description: Allocated storage in byte and memory in MB are shown if it set to True.

options.name: show_attribute
options.description: Attributes related to VM guest shown in information only when this is set V(true).

options.name: show_cluster
options.description: Tags virtual machine's cluster is shown if set to V(true).

options.name: show_datacenter
options.description: Tags virtual machine's datacenter is shown if set to V(true).

options.name: show_datastore
options.description: Tags virtual machine's datastore is shown if set to V(true).

options.name: show_esxi_hostname
options.description: Tags virtual machine's ESXi host is shown if set to V(true).

options.name: show_folder
options.description: Show folders

options.name: show_mac_address
options.description: Tags virtual machine's mac address is shown if set to V(true).

options.name: show_net
options.description: Tags virtual machine's network is shown if set to V(true).

options.name: show_resource_pool
options.description: Tags virtual machine's resource pool is shown if set to V(true).

options.name: show_tag
options.description: Tags related to virtual machine are shown if set to V(true).

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.

options.name: vm_name
options.description: Name of the virtual machine to get related configurations information from.

options.name: vm_type
options.description: If set to V(vm), then information are gathered for virtual machines only. If set to V(template), then information are gathered for virtual machine templates only. If set to V(all), then information are gathered for all virtual machines and virtual machine templates.
